subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly with China Southern Airlines via Guangzhou to Changsha, then travel by private coach to Furong Town, the ancient town hanging on a waterfall, and on to Zhangjiajie. You see the Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National Forest Park), the Grand Canyon glass bridge and more, with an English-speaking guide and 5-star hotels. The tour includes several shopping stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 21–26 2026 to Mar 20–25 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Furong Town: An ancient Tujia town built on a cliff beside a large waterfall; the visit includes a boat cruise and battery cart.
placeDesc.Junsheng Sandstone Painting Museum: A museum in Zhangjiajie showing paintings made from local colored sandstone.
placeDesc.72-Floor Stilts Tower: A tall, unusual tower in Zhangjiajie, seen on this tour from the outside.
placeDesc.Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National: A famous park of tall sandstone pillars that inspired the floating mountains in the movie Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A tall outdoor glass elevator built against a cliff, used to go up and down in the park.
placeDesc.Tianzishan: A high peak in the Zhangjiajie area reached by cable car, known for its forest of rock pillars.
placeDesc.No.1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge between two cliffs inside Zhangjiajie National Forest Park.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The sandstone pillar in the park that inspired the floating Hallelujah Mountains in Avatar.
placeDesc.West Sea Clouds: A scenic viewpoint in the Zhangjiajie area known for sea-of-clouds views among the peaks.
placeDesc.Golden Whip Stream: A scenic stream valley in Zhangjiajie with a long walking path between rocky cliffs.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon glass bridge: A glass bridge over a deep canyon in the Zhangjiajie region, with a VR experience included.
